Andison's expected shape index for a given fire area

Source: R/landmine-calibration.R
landmine_optim_shapeTarget.Rd

SHAPE = intercept + slope * log10(AREA)^4, fitted by Andison (1996) over fires of 10–3,000 ha. The default intercept is the one fitted to the empirical data (1.770, R^2 = 0.670, n = 928). The value 1.881 that also appears in the thesis is the fit to the model's own output, and targeting it would be circular.

landmine_optim_shapeTarget(areaHa, intercept = 1.77, slope = 0.041)

Arguments

areaHa

Fire area, in hectares.

intercept, slope

Coefficients; defaults are Andison's empirical fit.

Value

Expected shape index.

Examples

landmine_optim_shapeTarget(c(10, 100, 1000)) ## ~1.8, ~2.1, ~5.1
#> [1] 1.811 2.426 5.091
